def: Temporarily updating a model's parameters at inference with a loss derived from the test input itself, such as its in-context examples or a self-supervised objective, before answering.
practice: Per-task fine-tuning at inference gave up to 6x higher ARC accuracy than fine-tuned baselines (Akyürek et al.); TTT layers build the idea into an architecture whose hidden state is a small model trained on the sequence.
